sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 10:110

items.sefariaRef: Ohr Penimi on Talmud Eser HaSefirot 10:110:1
items.html: The throat of Arich Anpin, who is the Malchut of Hochma, and she is the Bina of the whole Partzuf of Arich Anpin: You already know that the upper does not bestow to the lower except from the discernment of its externality of Malchut (as above, page 913, the passage beginning ‘externality’). And from this discernment the throat is regarded as the Malchut of Mocha Stimaa. However, from its own discernment she is the Bina and SAG of the whole Partzuf.
